regime_context: Detector shows a single-eligible-theme market: only Banks clears the absolute-trend gate, with 21 of 22 themes ineligible, and rotation breadth is 0.05 (narrow). Critically, gate_helps is false for China A-shares — the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history — and the detector itself is honesty-stamped as rank-IC ~0 and display-only, so the state supports a lean on Banks only as a weak, falsifiable conditional, not as edge. Macro_narrative is dominated by ai_tech and geopolitics headlines but is coincident context, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the one-narrative structure widens: if a second theme clears eligibility (durability_bar passing the gate) while Banks' breadth falls below 0.5, that would be a confirmed leadership handoff worth re-reading; until then Banks remains the only eligible name and this watch retires only if Banks' crowding_z moves above 2.0 in a week of flat returns.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only eligible theme (clears the absolute-trend gate), leads the ranks, shows the strongest durability_bar (0.75, hurst_tag trend), and has positive breadth (0.611). However, gate_helps is false on this market, so the eligibility flag is an experimental sieve, not validated edge; the crowding_z of 1.6 (crowded=true) is only a size-down caution, never a fade.
theses.dissent: The same detector states the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on China A-shares history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws the gate), so eligibility here is not a validated edge and Banks' high crowding mean reflexivity cuts both ways; leading financials often top out on attention spikes.
